title: Cloud migration from Azure to GCP
description: We are seeking a senior cloud migration consultant to design a production-grade migration strategy from Azure to Google Cloud Platform. The engagement focuses on planning the migration of Kubernetes workloads from Azure Kubernetes Service to Google Kubernetes Engine and a ~1.1 TB PostgreSQL database from Azure Database for PostgreSQL to Cloud SQL or AlloyDB, with near-zero downtime and no data loss. The consultant will provide an end-to-end architecture, recommend a replication-based migration approach (e.g., logical replication or Google Database Migration Service), define a detailed cutover and rollback plan, and identify risks with mitigation strategies. Deliverables include a migration blueprint, step-by-step runbook, and validation approach. This is a short consultation engagement (2–5 hours) with potential follow-on implementation work.
